text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":480,"unit":"marbles","kind":"count","span":"480 marbles between them"},{"id":"q2","value":6,"unit":"marbles","kind":"count","span":"heaps of 6 marbles"},{"id":"q3","value":9,"unit":"marbles","kind":"count","span":"the other in heaps of 9 each"},{"id":"q4","value":72,"unit":"heaps","kind":"count","span":"the total number of heaps is 72"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"total marbles divided by 6 gives a reference point if all marbles were in heaps of 6, part of setting up the system of equations"},{"op":"div","args":["q1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"total marbles divided by 9 gives a similar reference point using heaps of 9"},{"op":"mul","args":["q4","q2"],"out":"s3","note":"total heaps times 6, part of relating the heap-count equation back to marbles"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"how many marbles each boy has"},"dismissed":[]}
